title: refactor(model3d): inline fal queue lifecycle
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the unused exported fal.ai job handle/state API and inlines its sole runFalJob lifecycle.
- Refreshes against current main while retaining the API-key override, configurable poll limit, five-second waits, last-poll completion, and existing error handling.
- Adds regression coverage for zero/exhausted poll limits, request ordering, delayed polling, and explicit credential forwarding; removes 51 net implementation lines.
- Validated: all 45 model3d tests, Gen typecheck, repository-pinned Biome, and diff whitespace checks against main.

gist.headline: One queue, fewer crumbs
gist.blurb: The fal.ai 3D job queue tidied itself into one smaller lifecycle. Same patient five-second polling, fewer loose handles buzzing around.
gist.summary: Refactored the model3d fal.ai client by removing its unused exported job-handle API and inlining the sole runFalJob lifecycle, while preserving API-key overrides, configurable poll limits, five-second waits, final-poll completion, and error handling.
gist.impact: 3D generation keeps the same fal.ai request and polling behavior, now backed by regression coverage for exhausted poll limits, request ordering, delayed polling, and explicit credential forwarding.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy garden-shed queue station where Polli organizes a single neat trail of fal.ai job tickets into a retro terminal, replacing several unused loose ticket holders. A small code-plant and five-second hourglass represent orderly delayed polling; Polli should look quietly pleased at the simpler setup.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-dark-brown striped bee mascot with black antennae, oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small smile, light blue translucent wings, and a tiny mechanic tool belt, neatly feeding one orderly line of job tickets into a lime green (#ecf874) glowing retro terminal while a small five-second hourglass and code-plants bloom beside it. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel mint-lavender-peach gradient background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, warm lighting, chunky retro sprites, subtle CRT glow, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, emotionally warm.
